title: Department store with huge escolars
content: Anyone been to the department store with giant escolars, like wide, multi lane, just to the right of the entrance? Entrance is also to the right, just wall to the left, and doors out to the front. Bonus: the home Depot/ Lowe's type store with a giant maze of fences outdoors. Bonus2: the southern super methed bargain dollar store that's huge and full of rednecks. Also with escolars.
